title: SG2 eye-state record (sg2-v1), one per frame, SG2 -> SG4

eye_valid.description: false when SG1 gave no valid face/eye points

method.description: name of the SG2 config that produced the record

ear.description: mean of left/right EAR (always geometric, for every method)

closed_score.description: method score, higher = more closed (EAR methods: -EAR or -EAR/open-level; CNN/blendshape: P(closed))

threshold.description: threshold applied to this frame (adaptive method: per-driver EAR threshold)

confidence.description: distance of the score from the threshold, scaled to 0..1

closed_duration_ms.description: length of the ongoing closure (0 when open) - lets SG4 react before the eyes reopen

blink_event.description: non-null only on the frame where a closure ENDS

type.description: long_closure = closed longer than max_blink_ms (500 ms)
